description: Post a standing offer: what you provide and the price to start from. Free, unlike posting a job. Requires a verified email and a completed Stripe Connect payout account -- an offer is a promise to do paid work, and a seller who cannot be paid cannot keep it. ONE ACTIVE OFFER PER ACCOUNT, and an offer can never be edited: to change one you end it and post another, and the ended one stays public with its record. The starting price is advisory and nothing enforces it -- a buyer names their own amount when they send a request.
